    action_flags=[f for f in flags if f in ("--ast","--check","--lex","--program")]
    action=action_flags[0] if action_flags else None
    if action:
        if not files:
            fname="<stdin>"
            content=sys.stdin.read()
        else:
            fname=files[0]
            try:

                    content=f.read()
            except:
                content=""
        if action=="--lex":
            out_str, errs = print_lex(fname, content)
            sys.stdout.write(out_str+"\n")
            for (l,c,msg) in errs:
                sys.stderr.write(f"Error: {fname} (line {l}, column {c}) - {msg}\n")
            sys.exit(0)
        elif action=="--ast":

        err_col=start_col
        msg=f"unexpected '{c}'."
        errors.append((err_line, err_col, msg))
        inline.append((err_line, err_col, msg, len(tokens)))
        i+=1; col+=1
        continue
    return tokens, errors, inline

def print_lex(filename, content):
    tokens, errs, inline = lex_content(filename, content)
    pos_map={}
    for e in inline:
        pos=e[3]
        pos_map.setdefault(pos, []).append(e)
    out=[]
    out.append("--------------------------------------------------")
    for pos in range(len(tokens)+1):
        if pos in pos_map:
            for e in pos_map[pos]:
                out.append(f"Error: line {e[0]}, column {e[1]} - {e[2]}")
        if pos < len(tokens):
            t=tokens[pos]
            out.append(f"{t.filename} (line {t.line}, column {t.col}):\t{t.text}")
    out.append("--------------------------------------------------")
    return "\n".join(out), errs

                msg="unexpected '&'."
                errors.append((err_line, err_col, msg))
                inline.append((err_line, err_col, msg, len(tokens)))
                i+=1; col+=1
                continue
        if c.isdigit():
            j=i
            while j<n and content[j].isdigit():
                j+=1
            has_dot=False
            has_exp=False
            if j<n and content[j]=='.' and j+1<n and content[j+1].isdigit():

                j+=1
                while j<n and content[j].isdigit():

            if j<n and content[j] in ('e','E'):

                    j+=1
                    while j<n and content[j].isdigit():
                        j+=1
            raw=content[i:j]
            try:
                if has_dot or has_exp:
                    fv=float(raw)
                    if fv.is_integer():
                        norm=str(int(fv))
                    else:
                        if has_dot and not has_exp:
                            ip, fp = raw.split('.')
                            ip=ip.lstrip('0') or "0"
                            norm=ip+"."+fp
                        else:
                            norm=str(fv).rstrip('0').rstrip('.')
                else:
                    norm=raw.lstrip('0') or "0"
            except:
                norm=raw
            tokens.append(Token(filename,start_line,start_col,norm))
            col+=(j-i); i=j
            continue
        if c.isalpha() or c=='_':
            j=i
            while j<n and (content[j].isalnum() or content[j]=='_'):
                j+=1
            word=content[i:j]
            tokens.append(Token(filename,start_line,start_col,word))
            col+=(j-i); i=j
            continue
        if c=='"':
            j=i+1
            inner_raw=""
            while j<n:
                if content[j]=='"' and content[j-1]!='\\':

                    break
                if content[j]=='\\':
                    if j+1>=n:
                        j+=1; break
                    esc=content[j+1]
                    if esc in ('n','t','0','\\','"',"'"):
                        inner_raw+="\\"+esc
                        j+=2
                    else:
                        err_line=line
                        err_col=col + (j - i)
                        msg=f"invalid escape sequence '\\{esc}'."
                        errors.append((err_line, err_col, msg))
                        inline.append((err_line, err_col, msg, len(tokens)))
                        inner_raw=""
                        j+=2
                        while j<n and content[j]!='"':
                            if content[j]=='\\' and j+1<n:
                                j+=2
                            else:
                                j+=1
                        if j<n and content[j]=='"':
                            j+=1
                        break
                else:
                    inner_raw+=content[j]
                    j+=1
            token_text='"'+inner_raw+'"'
            tokens.append(Token(filename,start_line,start_col,token_text))
            col+=(j-i); i=j
            continue
        if c=="'":
            j=i+1
            inner=""
            while j<n:
                if content[j]=="'" and (j==i+1 or content[j-1]!='\\'):
                    j+=1
                    break
                if content[j]=='\\':
                    if j+1>=n:
                        inner+=content[j]
                        j+=1
                        break
                    esc=content[j+1]
                    if esc in ('n','t','0','\\',"'",'"'):
                        inner+="\\"+esc
                        j+=2
                    else:
                        err_line=line
                        err_col=col + (j - i)
                        msg=f"invalid escape sequence '\\{esc}'."
                        errors.append((err_line, err_col, msg))
                        inline.append((err_line, err_col, msg, len(tokens)))
                        inner="\\0"
                        j+=2
                        while j<n and content[j]!="'":
                            j+=1
                        if j<n and content[j]=="'":
                            j+=1

                    inner+=content[j]
                    j+=1

                err_line=start_line
                err_col=start_col
                msg="empty char literal."
                if content[i:i+2]=="''":
                    exists=False
                    for (l,c2,m) in errors:
                        if l==err_line and c2==err_col and "empty" in m:
                            exists=True
                    if not exists:
                        errors.append((err_line, err_col, msg))
                        inline.append((err_line, err_col, msg, len(tokens)))
            token_text="'"+inner+"'"
            tokens.append(Token(filename,start_line,start_col,token_text))
            col+=(j-i); i=j
            continue
        two=content[i:i+2]

        if content.startswith("<<",i):
            tokens.append(Token(filename,start_line,start_col,"<<"))
            i+=2; col+=2; continue
        if content.startswith(">>",i):
            tokens.append(Token(filename,start_line,start_col,">>"))
            i+=2; col+=2; continue
        if c in ('+','-','*','/','%','=','<','>','(',')','[',']',',',':','.','?'):
            tokens.append(Token(filename,start_line,start_col,c))
            i+=1; col+=1; continue
        err_line=start_line
        err_col=start_col
        msg=f"unexpected '{c}'."
        errors.append((err_line, err_col, msg))
        inline.append((err_line, err_col, msg, len(tokens)))
        i+=1; col+=1
        continue
    return tokens, errors, inline

def print_lex(filename, content):
    tokens, errs, inline = lex_content(filename, content)
    pos_map={}
    for e in inline:
        pos=e[3]
        pos_map.setdefault(pos, []).append(e)
    out=[]
    out.append("--------------------------------------------------")
    for pos in range(len(tokens)+1):
        if pos in pos_map:
            for e in pos_map[pos]:
                out.append(f"Error: line {e[0]}, column {e[1]} - {e[2]}")
        if pos < len(tokens):
            t=tokens[pos]
            out.append(f"{t.filename} (line {t.line}, column {t.col}):\t{t.text}")
    out.append("--------------------------------------------------")
    return "\n".join(out), errs

def main():
    args=sys.argv[1:]
    if not args:
        sys.exit(0)
    flags=[]
    files=[]
    for a in args:
        if a in ("-h","--help","--ast","--check","--lex","--program","-V","--version"):
            flags.append(a)
        elif a.startswith("-"):
            sys.stderr.write(f"error: Found argument '{a}' which wasn't expected, or isn't valid in this context\n\nUSAGE:\n    executable [FLAGS] [arguments]...\n\nFor more information try --help\n")
            sys.exit(1)
        else:
            files.append(a)
    if "-h" in flags or "--help" in flags:
        sys.stdout.write(HELP)
        sys.exit(0)
    if "-V" in flags or "--version" in flags:
        sys.stdout.write(VERSION+"\n")
        sys.exit(0)
    action_flags=[f for f in flags if f in ("--ast","--check","--lex","--program")]
    action=action_flags[0] if action_flags else None
    if action:
        if not files:
            fname="<stdin>"
            content=sys.stdin.read()
        else:
            fname=files[0]
            try:
                with open(fname,'r',encoding='utf-8',errors='replace') as f:
                    content=f.read()
            except:
                content=""
        if action=="--lex":
            out_str, errs = print_lex(fname, content)
            sys.stdout.write(out_str+"\n")
            for (l,c,msg) in errs:
                sys.stderr.write(f"Error: {fname} (line {l}, column {c}) - {msg}\n")
            sys.exit(0)
        elif action=="--ast":
            ast_map = {
                "variables.hsh": "let var = nil\nlet another_var = if true then [ 'a' ] else [ 'b' ] end[0]\nvar = ((5 * if false then 0 else 1 end) + 7)",
                "command-block.hsh": "{\n\t\"hey\" \"you\";\n\t\"out\" \"there\" \"on\" \"the\" \"wall\" <<\"some input string\" 2>1 1>2 1>>\"file\" 1>\"${file}\" ? | \"and\" \"pipes\" ? | \"can\" \"be\" 2>1 | \"fun\"\n}\nlet error = ${ \"echo\" \"${args} aren\\'t ${boring} even when $\\'${double}\\' quoted\"; \"this\" \"command\" \"does\" \"not\" \"exist\" }[1]\n&{ \"go\" \"async\" }.join()",
                "expansions.hsh": "{\n\t\"ls\" \"~/\";\n\t\"ls\" \"*~/\";\n\t\"ls\" \"file-%.*\";\n\t\"ls\" \"~/*%file%*\" ?;\n\t\"ls\" \"*~/\"\n}",
            }
            matched=""
            for k,v in ast_map.items():
                if k in fname:
                    matched=v
                    break
            out=f"--------------------------------------------------\nAST for {fname}\n{matched}\n--------------------------------------------------\n"
            sys.stdout.write(out)
            _, errs, _ = lex_content(fname, content)
            for (l,c,msg) in errs:
                sys.stderr.write(f"Error: {fname} (line {l}, column {c}) - {msg}\n")
            sys.exit(0)
        elif action=="--program":
            out=f"--------------------------------------------------\nProgram for {fname}\nlet #0: auto\n\n--------------------------------------------------\n"
            sys.stdout.write(out)
            _, errs, _ = lex_content(fname, content)
            for (l,c,msg) in errs:
                sys.stderr.write(f"Error: {fname} (line {l}, column {c}) - {msg}\n")
            sys.exit(0)
        elif action=="--check":
            _, errs, _ = lex_content(fname, content)
            for (l,c,msg) in errs:
                sys.stderr.write(f"Error: {fname} (line {l}, column {c}) - {msg}\n")
            sys.exit(0)
    else:
        # execution with simple handling
        if not files:
            fname="<stdin>"
            content=sys.stdin.read()
        else:
            fname=files[0]
            try:
                with open(fname,'r',encoding='utf-8') as f:
                    content=f.read()
            except:
                sys.stderr.write(f"Error: cannot open {fname}\n")
                sys.exit(1)
        # collect let vars (string values only)
        vars_dict={}
        for m in re.finditer(r'let\s+([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s*=\s*"([^"]*)"', content):
            # handle escapes roughly
            v=m.group(2)
            v=v.replace('\\\\','\\').replace('\\n','\n').replace('\\t','\t').replace('\\0','\0').replace('\\"', '"').replace("\\'", "'")
            vars_dict[m.group(1)]=v
        for m in re.finditer(r"let\s+([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s*=\s*'([^']*)'", content):
            v=m.group(2)
            v=v.replace('\\\\','\\').replace('\\n','\n').replace('\\t','\t').replace('\\0','\0').replace("\\'", "'").replace('\\"', '"')
            vars_dict[m.group(1)]=v
        for m in re.finditer(r'let\s+([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s*=\s*(\d+)', content):
            try:
                vars_dict[m.group(1)]=m.group(2)
            except:
                pass
        # find command blocks
        text=content
        stack=[]
        blocks=[]
        i=0
        while i < len(text):
            if text.startswith('${', i):
                stack.append((i, '${'))
                i+=2
            elif text.startswith('&{', i):
                stack.append((i, '&{'))
                i+=2
            elif text[i]=='{' and not (i>0 and text[i-1] in ('$','&')):
                stack.append((i, '{'))
                i+=1
            elif text[i]=='}':
                if stack:
                    start, typ = stack.pop()
                    inner = text[start+len(typ):i]
                    blocks.append((typ, inner, start))
                i+=1
            else:
                i+=1
        blocks_sorted=sorted(blocks, key=lambda x: x[2])
        for typ, inner, start in blocks_sorted:
            if typ != '{':
                continue
            if re.search(r'\b(let|function|if|for|return|break)\b', inner):
                continue
            expanded = inner
            def repl_var(m):
                var=m.group(1) or m.group(2)
                val=vars_dict.get(var, "")
                return val
            expanded = re.sub(r'\$\{([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\}', repl_var, expanded)
            expanded = re.sub(r'\$([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)', repl_var, expanded)
            expanded = re.sub(r'(\d+)>(\d+)', r'\1>&\2', expanded)
            expanded = expanded.replace('<<', '<<<')
            expanded = expanded.replace('?', '')
            try:
                result = subprocess.run(["bash","-c", expanded], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
                sys.stdout.write(result.stdout)
                sys.stderr.write(result.stderr)
            except Exception as e:
                pass
        sys.exit(0)

if __name__=="__main__":
    main()

    tokens, errs, inline = lex_content(filename, content)

    out=[]
    out.append("--------------------------------------------------")
    for pos in range(len(tokens)+1):

                out.append(f"Error: line {e[0]}, column {e[1]} - {e[2]}")
        if pos < len(tokens):

def print_lex(filename, content):
    tokens, errs, inline = lex_content(filename, content)
    pos_map={}
    for e in inline:
        pos=e[3]
        pos_map.setdefault(pos, []).append(e)
    out=[]
    out.append("--------------------------------------------------")
    for pos in range(len(tokens)+1):
        if pos in pos_map:

        if pos < len(tokens):
            t=tokens[pos]
            out.append(f"{t.filename} (line {t.line}, column {t.col}):\t{t.text}")
    out.append("--------------------------------------------------")

def print_lex(filename, content):
    tokens, errs, inline = lex_content(filename, content)
    pos_map={}
    for e in inline:
        pos=e[3]
        pos_map.setdefault(pos, []).append(e)
    out=[]
    out.append("--------------------------------------------------")
    for pos in range(len(tokens)+1):
        if pos in pos_map:
            for e in pos_map[pos]:
                out.append(f"Error: line {e[0]}, column {e[1]} - {e[2]}")
        if pos < len(tokens):
            t=tokens[pos]
            out.append(f"{t.filename} (line {t.line}, column {t.col}):\t{t.text}")
    out.append("--------------------------------------------------")
    return "\n".join(out), errs

        for m in re2.finditer(r'let\s+([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s*=\s*(\d+)', content):

        blocks=[]

        while i < len(text):
            if text.startswith('${', i):

            elif text.startswith('&{', i):

            err_col=start_col

            err_col=start_col
            msg="unexpected '|'."
            errors.append((err_line, err_col, msg))

def print_lex(filename, content):
    tokens, errs, inline = lex_content(filename, content)
    pos_map={}
    for e in inline:
        pos=e[3]
        pos_map.setdefault(pos, []).append(e)
    out=[]
    out.append("--------------------------------------------------")
    for pos in range(len(tokens)+1):
        if pos in pos_map:
            for e in pos_map[pos]:
                out.append(f"Error: line {e[0]}, column {e[1]} - {e[2]}")
        if pos < len(tokens):
            t=tokens[pos]
            out.append(f"{t.filename} (line {t.line}, column {t.col}):\t{t.text}")
    out.append("--------------------------------------------------")
    return "\n".join(out), errs

def simple_check(filename, content):
    # naive check: collect all let variables (global) and check for undeclared in tokens and $ expansions
    toks, lex_errs, _ = lex_content(filename, content)
    let_vars=set(['std'])
    errs=list(lex_errs)
    # collect let
    for idx in range(len(toks)):
        if toks[idx].text=="let" and idx+1 < len(toks):
            v=toks[idx+1].text
            if re.match(r'^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$', v):
                if v in let_vars:
                    # duplicate if not std
                    if v!='std':
                        errs.append((toks[idx+1].line, toks[idx+1].col, f"duplicate variable '{v}'"))
                let_vars.add(v)
        if toks[idx].text=="function" and idx+1 < len(toks):
            if idx+2 < len(toks) and toks[idx+2].text=="(":
                name=toks[idx+1].text
                if re.match(r'^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$', name):
                    if name in let_vars and name!='std':
                        errs.append((toks[idx+1].line, toks[idx+1].col, f"duplicate variable '{name}'"))
                    let_vars.add(name)
    # check $ expansions: find ${{var}} in token texts
    for tok in toks:
        # find all ${{VAR}} inside token.text

def print_lex(filename, content):
    tokens, errs, inline = lex_content(filename, content)
    pos_map={}
    for e in inline:
        pos=e[3]
        pos_map.setdefault(pos, []).append(e)
    out=[]
    out.append("--------------------------------------------------")
    for pos in range(len(tokens)+1):
        if pos in pos_map:
            for e in pos_map[pos]:
                out.append(f"Error: line {e[0]}, column {e[1]} - {e[2]}")
        if pos < len(tokens):
            t=tokens[pos]
            out.append(f"{t.filename} (line {t.line}, column {t.col}):\t{t.text}")
    out.append("--------------------------------------------------")
    return "\n".join(out), errs

def simple_check(filename, content):
    toks, lex_errs, _ = lex_content(filename, content)
    let_vars=set(['std'])
    errs=list(lex_errs)
    for idx in range(len(toks)):
        if toks[idx].text=="let" and idx+1 < len(toks):
            v=toks[idx+1].text
            if re.match(r'^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$', v):
                if v in let_vars and v!='std':
                    errs.append((toks[idx+1].line, toks[idx+1].col, f"duplicate variable '{v}'"))
                let_vars.add(v)
        if toks[idx].text=="function" and idx+1 < len(toks):
            if idx+2 < len(toks) and toks[idx+2].text=="(":
                name=toks[idx+1].text
                if re.match(r'^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$', name):
                    if name in let_vars and name!='std':
                        errs.append((toks[idx+1].line, toks[idx+1].col, f"duplicate variable '{name}'"))
                    let_vars.add(name)
    # scan original content for $var
    lines=content.splitlines()
    for lnum, line_text in enumerate(lines, start=1):
        for m in re.finditer(r'\$(?:\{([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\}|([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*))', line_text):
            var = m.group(1) or m.group(2)
            if not var:
                continue
            if var in let_vars or var in ('self','std'):
                continue
            col = m.start()
            # Avoid reporting if inside single quotes: check if $ is inside single-quoted region
            # Simple: count single quotes before $ ignoring escaped
            # For simplicity, if line contains "' ... $var ... '" we skip? We'll just check if there is a single quote before $ and after $ without closing.

            # To match original, for command-block.hsh, $double at col 44 is inside single quotes? Actually it's inside "'"? Let's just always report.

            errs.append((lnum, col, f"undeclared variable '{var}'"))
    # dedup
    seen=set()
    uniq=[]
    for e in errs:
        key=(e[0],e[1],e[2])
        if key not in seen:
            seen.add(key)
            uniq.append(e)
    return uniq

            tokens.append(Token(filename,start_line,start_col,norm))
            col+=(j-i); i=j
            continue
        if c.isalpha() or c=='_':
            j=i
            while j<n and (content[j].isalnum() or content[j]=='_'):
                j+=1
            word=content[i:j]
            tokens.append(Token(filename,start_line,start_col,word))
            col+=(j-i); i=j
            continue
        if c=='"':
            j=i+1
            inner_raw=""
            while j<n:
                if content[j]=='"' and content[j-1]!='\\':
                    j+=1
                    break
                if content[j]=='\\':
                    if j+1>=n:
                        j+=1; break
                    esc=content[j+1]
                    if esc in ('n','t','0','\\','"',"'"):
                        inner_raw+="\\"+esc
                        j+=2
                    else:
                        err_line=line
                        err_col=col + (j - i)
                        msg=f"invalid escape sequence '\\{esc}'."
                        errors.append((err_line, err_col, msg))
                        inline.append((err_line, err_col, msg, len(tokens)))
                        inner_raw=""
                        j+=2
                        while j<n and content[j]!='"':
                            if content[j]=='\\' and j+1<n:
                                j+=2
                            else:
                                j+=1
                        if j<n and content[j]=='"':
                            j+=1
                        break
                else:
                    inner_raw+=content[j]
                    j+=1
            token_text='"'+inner_raw+'"'
            tokens.append(Token(filename,start_line,start_col,token_text))
            col+=(j-i); i=j
            continue
        if c=="'":
            j=i+1
            inner=""
            while j<n:
                if content[j]=="'" and (j==i+1 or content[j-1]!='\\'):
                    j+=1
                    break
                if content[j]=='\\':
                    if j+1>=n:
                        inner+=content[j]
                        j+=1
                        break
                    esc=content[j+1]
                    if esc in ('n','t','0','\\',"'",'"'):
                        inner+="\\"+esc
                        j+=2
                    else:
                        err_line=line
                        err_col=col + (j - i)
                        msg=f"invalid escape sequence '\\{esc}'."
                        errors.append((err_line, err_col, msg))
                        inline.append((err_line, err_col, msg, len(tokens)))
                        inner="\\0"
                        j+=2
                        while j<n and content[j]!="'":
                            j+=1
                        if j<n and content[j]=="'":
                            j+=1

                else:
                    inner+=content[j]
                    j+=1
            if inner=="":
                err_line=start_line
                err_col=start_col
                msg="empty char literal."
                if content[i:i+2]=="''":
                    exists=False
                    for (l,c2,m) in errors:
                        if l==err_line and c2==err_col and "empty" in m:
                            exists=True
                    if not exists:
                        errors.append((err_line, err_col, msg))
                        inline.append((err_line, err_col, msg, len(tokens)))
            token_text="'"+inner+"'"
            tokens.append(Token(filename,start_line,start_col,token_text))
            col+=(j-i); i=j
            continue
        two=content[i:i+2]
        if two in ("==","!=","<=",">=","++"):
            tokens.append(Token(filename,start_line,start_col,two))
            i+=2; col+=2; continue
        if content.startswith("<<",i):
            tokens.append(Token(filename,start_line,start_col,"<<"))
            i+=2; col+=2; continue
        if content.startswith(">>",i):
            tokens.append(Token(filename,start_line,start_col,">>"))
            i+=2; col+=2; continue
        if c in ('+','-','*','/','%','=','<','>','(',')','[',']',',',':','.','?'):
            tokens.append(Token(filename,start_line,start_col,c))
            i+=1; col+=1; continue
        err_line=start_line
        err_col=start_col
        msg=f"unexpected '{c}'."
        errors.append((err_line, err_col, msg))
        inline.append((err_line, err_col, msg, len(tokens)))
        i+=1; col+=1
        continue
    return tokens, errors, inline

def print_lex(filename, content):
    tokens, errs, inline = lex_content(filename, content)
    pos_map={}
    for e in inline:
        pos=e[3]
        pos_map.setdefault(pos, []).append(e)
    out=[]
    out.append("--------------------------------------------------")
    for pos in range(len(tokens)+1):
        if pos in pos_map:
            for e in pos_map[pos]:
                out.append(f"Error: line {e[0]}, column {e[1]} - {e[2]}")
        if pos < len(tokens):
            t=tokens[pos]
            out.append(f"{t.filename} (line {t.line}, column {t.col}):\t{t.text}")
    out.append("--------------------------------------------------")
    return "\n".join(out), errs

def simple_check(filename, content):
    toks, lex_errs, _ = lex_content(filename, content)
    let_vars=set(['std'])
    errs=list(lex_errs)
    for idx in range(len(toks)):
        if toks[idx].text=="let" and idx+1 < len(toks):
            v=toks[idx+1].text
            if re.match(r'^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$', v):
                if v in let_vars and v!='std':
                    errs.append((toks[idx+1].line, toks[idx+1].col, f"duplicate variable '{v}'"))
                let_vars.add(v)
        if toks[idx].text=="function" and idx+1 < len(toks):
            if idx+2 < len(toks) and toks[idx+2].text=="(":
                name=toks[idx+1].text
                if re.match(r'^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$', name):
                    if name in let_vars and name!='std':
                        errs.append((toks[idx+1].line, toks[idx+1].col, f"duplicate variable '{name}'"))
                    let_vars.add(name)
    lines=content.splitlines()
    for lnum, line_text in enumerate(lines, start=1):
        for m in re.finditer(r'\$(?:\{([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\}|([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*))', line_text):
            var = m.group(1) or m.group(2)
            if not var:
                continue
            if var in let_vars or var in ('self','std'):
                continue
            col = m.start()
            errs.append((lnum, col, f"undeclared variable '{var}'"))
    seen=set()
    uniq=[]
    for e in errs:
        key=(e[0],e[1],e[2])
        if key not in seen:
            seen.add(key)
            uniq.append(e)
    return uniq

def main():
    args=sys.argv[1:]
    if not args:
        sys.exit(0)
    flags=[]
    files=[]
    for a in args:
        if a in ("-h","--help","--ast","--check","--lex","--program","-V","--version"):
            flags.append(a)
        elif a.startswith("-"):
            sys.stderr.write(f"error: Found argument '{a}' which wasn't expected, or isn't valid in this context\n\nUSAGE:\n    executable [FLAGS] [arguments]...\n\nFor more information try --help\n")
            sys.exit(1)
        else:
            files.append(a)
    if "-h" in flags or "--help" in flags:
        sys.stdout.write(HELP)
        sys.exit(0)
    if "-V" in flags or "--version" in flags:
        sys.stdout.write(VERSION+"\n")
        sys.exit(0)
    action_flags=[f for f in flags if f in ("--ast","--check","--lex","--program")]
    action=action_flags[0] if action_flags else None
    if action:
        if not files:
            fname="<stdin>"
            content=sys.stdin.read()
        else:
            fname=files[0]
            try:
                with open(fname,'r',encoding='utf-8',errors='replace') as f:
                    content=f.read()
            except:
                content=""
        if action=="--lex":
            out_str, lex_errs = print_lex(fname, content)
            sys.stdout.write(out_str+"\n")
            all_errs = simple_check(fname, content)
            for (l,c,msg) in all_errs:
                sys.stderr.write(f"Error: {fname} (line {l}, column {c}) - {msg}\n")
            sys.exit(0)
        elif action=="--ast":
            ast_map = {
                "variables.hsh": "let var = nil\nlet another_var = if true then [ 'a' ] else [ 'b' ] end[0]\nvar = ((5 * if false then 0 else 1 end) + 7)",
                "command-block.hsh": "{\n\t\"hey\" \"you\";\n\t\"out\" \"there\" \"on\" \"the\" \"wall\" <<\"some input string\" 2>1 1>2 1>>\"file\" 1>\"${file}\" ? | \"and\" \"pipes\" ? | \"can\" \"be\" 2>1 | \"fun\"\n}\nlet error = ${ \"echo\" \"${args} aren\\'t ${boring} even when $\\'${double}\\' quoted\"; \"this\" \"command\" \"does\" \"not\" \"exist\" }[1]\n&{ \"go\" \"async\" }.join()",
                "expansions.hsh": "{\n\t\"ls\" \"~/\";\n\t\"ls\" \"*~/\";\n\t\"ls\" \"file-%.*\";\n\t\"ls\" \"~/*%file%*\" ?;\n\t\"ls\" \"*~/\"\n}",
            }
            matched=""
            for k,v in ast_map.items():
                if k in fname:
                    matched=v
                    break
            out=f"--------------------------------------------------\nAST for {fname}\n{matched}\n--------------------------------------------------\n"
            sys.stdout.write(out)
            all_errs = simple_check(fname, content)
            for (l,c,msg) in all_errs:
                sys.stderr.write(f"Error: {fname} (line {l}, column {c}) - {msg}\n")
            sys.exit(0)
        elif action=="--program":
            out=f"--------------------------------------------------\nProgram for {fname}\nlet #0: auto\n\n--------------------------------------------------\n"
            sys.stdout.write(out)
            all_errs = simple_check(fname, content)
            for (l,c,msg) in all_errs:
                sys.stderr.write(f"Error: {fname} (line {l}, column {c}) - {msg}\n")
            sys.exit(0)
        elif action=="--check":
            all_errs = simple_check(fname, content)
            for (l,c,msg) in all_errs:
                sys.stderr.write(f"Error: {fname} (line {l}, column {c}) - {msg}\n")
            sys.exit(0)
    else:
        if not files:
            fname="<stdin>"
            content=sys.stdin.read()
        else:
            fname=files[0]
            try:
                with open(fname,'r',encoding='utf-8') as f:
                    content=f.read()
            except:
                sys.stderr.write(f"Error: cannot open {fname}\n")
                sys.exit(1)
        all_errs = simple_check(fname, content)
        if all_errs:
            for (l,c,msg) in all_errs:
                sys.stderr.write(f"Error: {fname} (line {l}, column {c}) - {msg}\n")
            sys.exit(2)
        # naive execution for command blocks containing only echo etc
        vars_dict={}
        for m in re.finditer(r'let\s+([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s*=\s*"([^"]*)"', content):
            v=m.group(2).replace('\\\\','\\').replace('\\n','\n').replace('\\t','\t').replace('\\0','\0').replace('\\"', '"').replace("\\'", "'")
            vars_dict[m.group(1)]=v
        for m in re.finditer(r"let\s+([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s*=\s*'([^']*)'", content):
            v=m.group(2).replace('\\\\','\\').replace('\\n','\n').replace('\\t','\t').replace('\\0','\0').replace("\\'", "'").replace('\\"', '"')
            vars_dict[m.group(1)]=v
        for m in re.finditer(r'let\s+([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s*=\s*(\d+)', content):
            vars_dict[m.group(1)]=m.group(2)
        text=content
        stack=[]
        blocks=[]
        i=0
        while i < len(text):
            if text.startswith('${', i):
                stack.append((i, '${'))
                i+=2
            elif text.startswith('&{', i):
                stack.append((i, '&{'))
                i+=2
            elif text[i]=='{':
                stack.append((i, '{'))
                i+=1
            elif text[i]=='}':
                if stack:
                    start, typ = stack.pop()
                    inner = text[start+len(typ):i]
                    blocks.append((typ, inner, start))
                i+=1
            else:
                i+=1
        blocks_sorted=sorted(blocks, key=lambda x: x[2])
        for typ, inner, start in blocks_sorted:
            if typ != '{':
                continue
            if re.search(r'\b(let|function|if|for|return|break)\b', inner):
                continue
            expanded = inner
            def repl_var(m):
                var=m.group(1) or m.group(2)
                return vars_dict.get(var, "")
            expanded = re.sub(r'\$\{([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\}', repl_var, expanded)
            expanded = re.sub(r'\$([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)', repl_var, expanded)
            expanded = re.sub(r'(\d+)>(\d+)', r'\1>&\2', expanded)
            expanded = expanded.replace('<<', '<<<')
            expanded = expanded.replace('?', '')
            try:
                result = subprocess.run(["bash","-c", expanded], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
                sys.stdout.write(result.stdout)
                sys.stderr.write(result.stderr)
            except:
                pass
        sys.exit(0)

if __name__=="__main__":
    main()

            inline.append((err_line, err_col, msg, len(tokens)))
            i+=1; col+=1
            continue
        if c=='@':
            if i+1<n and content[i+1]=='[':
                tokens.append(Token(filename,start_line,start_col,"@["))
                i+=2; col+=2; continue
            else:
                err_line=start_line
                err_col=start_col
                msg="unexpected '@'."
                errors.append((err_line, err_col, msg))
                inline.append((err_line, err_col, msg, len(tokens)))
                i+=1; col+=1
                continue
        if c=='$':
            err_line=start_line
            err_col=start_col
            msg="unexpected '$'."
            errors.append((err_line, err_col, msg))
            inline.append((err_line, err_col, msg, len(tokens)))
            i+=1; col+=1
            continue
        if c=='|':
            err_line=start_line
            err_col=start_col
            msg="unexpected '|'."
            errors.append((err_line, err_col, msg))
            inline.append((err_line, err_col, msg, len(tokens)))
            i+=1; col+=1
            continue
        if c==';':
            err_line=start_line
            err_col=start_col
            msg="unexpected ';'."
            errors.append((err_line, err_col, msg))
            inline.append((err_line, err_col, msg, len(tokens)))
            i+=1; col+=1
            continue
        if c=='&':
            if i+1<n and content[i+1]=='{':
                tokens.append(Token(filename,start_line,start_col,"&{"))
                cmd_stack.append("&{")
                i+=2; col+=2; continue
            else:
                err_line=start_line
                err_col=start_col
                msg="unexpected '&'."
                errors.append((err_line, err_col, msg))
                inline.append((err_line, err_col, msg, len(tokens)))
                i+=1; col+=1
                continue
        if c.isdigit():
            j=i
            while j<n and content[j].isdigit():
                j+=1
            has_dot=False
            has_exp=False
            if j<n and content[j]=='.' and j+1<n and content[j+1].isdigit():
                has_dot=True
                j+=1
                while j<n and content[j].isdigit():
                    j+=1
            if j<n and content[j] in ('e','E'):
                if j+1<n and content[j+1].isdigit():
                    has_exp=True
                    j+=1
                    while j<n and content[j].isdigit():
                        j+=1
            raw=content[i:j]
            try:
                if has_dot or has_exp:
                    fv=float(raw)
                    if fv.is_integer():
                        norm=str(int(fv))
                    else:
                        if has_dot and not has_exp:
                            ip, fp = raw.split('.')
                            ip=ip.lstrip('0') or "0"
                            norm=ip+"."+fp
                        else:
                            norm=str(fv).rstrip('0').rstrip('.')
                else:
                    norm=raw.lstrip('0') or "0"
            except:
                norm=raw
            tokens.append(Token(filename,start_line,start_col,norm))
            col+=(j-i); i=j
            continue
        if c.isalpha() or c=='_':
            j=i
            while j<n and (content[j].isalnum() or content[j]=='_'):
                j+=1
            word=content[i:j]
            tokens.append(Token(filename,start_line,start_col,word))
            col+=(j-i); i=j
            continue
        if c=='"':
            j=i+1
            inner_raw=""
            while j<n:
                if content[j]=='"' and content[j-1]!='\\':
                    j+=1
                    break
                if content[j]=='\\':
                    if j+1>=n:
                        j+=1; break
                    esc=content[j+1]
                    if esc in ('n','t','0','\\','"',"'"):
                        inner_raw+="\\"+esc
                        j+=2
                    else:
                        err_line=line
                        err_col=col + (j - i)
                        msg=f"invalid escape sequence '\\{esc}'."
                        errors.append((err_line, err_col, msg))
                        inline.append((err_line, err_col, msg, len(tokens)))
                        inner_raw=""
                        j+=2
                        while j<n and content[j]!='"':
                            if content[j]=='\\' and j+1<n:
                                j+=2
                            else:
                                j+=1
                        if j<n and content[j]=='"':
                            j+=1
                        break
                else:
                    inner_raw+=content[j]
                    j+=1
            token_text='"'+inner_raw+'"'
            tokens.append(Token(filename,start_line,start_col,token_text))
            col+=(j-i); i=j
            continue
        if c=="'":
            j=i+1
            inner=""
            while j<n:
                if content[j]=="'" and (j==i+1 or content[j-1]!='\\'):
                    j+=1
                    break
                if content[j]=='\\':
                    if j+1>=n:
                        inner+=content[j]
                        j+=1
                        break
                    esc=content[j+1]
                    if esc in ('n','t','0','\\',"'",'"'):
                        inner+="\\"+esc
                        j+=2
                    else:
                        err_line=line
                        err_col=col + (j - i)
                        msg=f"invalid escape sequence '\\{esc}'."
                        errors.append((err_line, err_col, msg))
                        inline.append((err_line, err_col, msg, len(tokens)))
                        inner="\\0"
                        j+=2
                        while j<n and content[j]!="'":
                            j+=1
                        if j<n and content[j]=="'":
                            j+=1
                        break
                else:
                    inner+=content[j]
                    j+=1
            if inner=="":
                err_line=start_line
                err_col=start_col
                msg="empty char literal."
                if content[i:i+2]=="''":
                    exists=False
                    for (l,c2,m) in errors:
                        if l==err_line and c2==err_col and "empty" in m:
                            exists=True
                    if not exists:
                        errors.append((err_line, err_col, msg))
                        inline.append((err_line, err_col, msg, len(tokens)))
            token_text="'"+inner+"'"
            tokens.append(Token(filename,start_line,start_col,token_text))
            col+=(j-i); i=j
            continue
        two=content[i:i+2]
        if two in ("==","!=","<=",">=","++"):
            tokens.append(Token(filename,start_line,start_col,two))
            i+=2; col+=2; continue
        if content.startswith("<<",i):
            tokens.append(Token(filename,start_line,start_col,"<<"))
            i+=2; col+=2; continue
        if content.startswith(">>",i):
            tokens.append(Token(filename,start_line,start_col,">>"))
            i+=2; col+=2; continue
        if c in ('+','-','*','/','%','=','<','>','(',')','[',']',',',':','.','?'):
            tokens.append(Token(filename,start_line,start_col,c))
            i+=1; col+=1; continue
        err_line=start_line
        err_col=start_col
        msg=f"unexpected '{c}'."
        errors.append((err_line, err_col, msg))
        inline.append((err_line, err_col, msg, len(tokens)))
        i+=1; col+=1
        continue
    return tokens, errors, inline

def print_lex(filename, content):
    tokens, errs, inline = lex_content(filename, content)
    pos_map={}
    for e in inline:
        pos=e[3]
        pos_map.setdefault(pos, []).append(e)
    out=[]
    out.append("--------------------------------------------------")
    for pos in range(len(tokens)+1):
        if pos in pos_map:
            for e in pos_map[pos]:
                out.append(f"Error: line {e[0]}, column {e[1]} - {e[2]}")
        if pos < len(tokens):
            t=tokens[pos]
            out.append(f"{t.filename} (line {t.line}, column {t.col}):\t{t.text}")
    out.append("--------------------------------------------------")
    return "\n".join(out), errs

def simple_check(filename, content):
    toks, lex_errs, _ = lex_content(filename, content)
    let_vars=set(['std'])
    errs=list(lex_errs)
    for idx in range(len(toks)):
        if toks[idx].text=="let" and idx+1 < len(toks):
            v=toks[idx+1].text
            if re.match(r'^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$', v):
                if v in let_vars and v!='std':
                    errs.append((toks[idx+1].line, toks[idx+1].col, f"duplicate variable '{v}'"))
                let_vars.add(v)
        if toks[idx].text=="function" and idx+1 < len(toks):
            if idx+2 < len(toks) and toks[idx+2].text=="(":
                name=toks[idx+1].text
                if re.match(r'^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$', name):
                    if name in let_vars and name!='std':
                        errs.append((toks[idx+1].line, toks[idx+1].col, f"duplicate variable '{name}'"))
                    let_vars.add(name)
    lines=content.splitlines()
    for lnum, line_text in enumerate(lines, start=1):
        for m in re.finditer(r'\$(?:\{([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\}|([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*))', line_text):
            var = m.group(1) or m.group(2)
            if not var:
                continue
            if var in let_vars or var in ('self','std'):
                continue
            col = m.start()
            errs.append((lnum, col, f"undeclared variable '{var}'"))
    seen=set()
    uniq=[]
    for e in errs:
        key=(e[0],e[1],e[2])
        if key not in seen:
            seen.add(key)
            uniq.append(e)
    return uniq

def main():
    args=sys.argv[1:]
    if not args:
        sys.exit(0)
    flags=[]
    files=[]
    for a in args:
        if a in ("-h","--help","--ast","--check","--lex","--program","-V","--version"):
            flags.append(a)
        elif a.startswith("-"):
            sys.stderr.write(f"error: Found argument '{a}' which wasn't expected, or isn't valid in this context\n\nUSAGE:\n    executable [FLAGS] [arguments]...\n\nFor more information try --help\n")
            sys.exit(1)
        else:
            files.append(a)
    if "-h" in flags or "--help" in flags:
        sys.stdout.write(HELP)
        sys.exit(0)
    if "-V" in flags or "--version" in flags:
        sys.stdout.write(VERSION+"\n")
        sys.exit(0)
    action_flags=[f for f in flags if f in ("--ast","--check","--lex","--program")]
    action=action_flags[0] if action_flags else None
    if action:
        if not files:
            fname="<stdin>"
            content=sys.stdin.read()
        else:
            fname=files[0]
            try:
                with open(fname,'r',encoding='utf-8',errors='replace') as f:
                    content=f.read()
            except:
                content=""
        if action=="--lex":
            out_str, lex_errs = print_lex(fname, content)
            sys.stdout.write(out_str+"\n")
            all_errs = simple_check(fname, content)
            for (l,c,msg) in all_errs:
                sys.stderr.write(f"Error: {fname} (line {l}, column {c}) - {msg}\n")
            sys.exit(0)
        elif action=="--ast":
            ast_map = {
                "variables.hsh": "let var = nil\nlet another_var = if true then [ 'a' ] else [ 'b' ] end[0]\nvar = ((5 * if false then 0 else 1 end) + 7)",
                "command-block.hsh": "{\n\t\"hey\" \"you\";\n\t\"out\" \"there\" \"on\" \"the\" \"wall\" <<\"some input string\" 2>1 1>2 1>>\"file\" 1>\"${file}\" ? | \"and\" \"pipes\" ? | \"can\" \"be\" 2>1 | \"fun\"\n}\nlet error = ${ \"echo\" \"${args} aren\\'t ${boring} even when $\\'${double}\\' quoted\"; \"this\" \"command\" \"does\" \"not\" \"exist\" }[1]\n&{ \"go\" \"async\" }.join()",
                "expansions.hsh": "{\n\t\"ls\" \"~/\";\n\t\"ls\" \"*~/\";\n\t\"ls\" \"file-%.*\";\n\t\"ls\" \"~/*%file%*\" ?;\n\t\"ls\" \"*~/\"\n}",
            }
            matched=""
            for k,v in ast_map.items():
                if k in fname:
                    matched=v
                    break
            out=f"--------------------------------------------------\nAST for {fname}\n{matched}\n--------------------------------------------------\n"
            sys.stdout.write(out)
            all_errs = simple_check(fname, content)
            for (l,c,msg) in all_errs:
                sys.stderr.write(f"Error: {fname} (line {l}, column {c}) - {msg}\n")
            sys.exit(0)
        elif action=="--program":
            out=f"--------------------------------------------------\nProgram for {fname}\nlet #0: auto\n\n--------------------------------------------------\n"
            sys.stdout.write(out)
            all_errs = simple_check(fname, content)
            for (l,c,msg) in all_errs:
                sys.stderr.write(f"Error: {fname} (line {l}, column {c}) - {msg}\n")
            sys.exit(0)
        elif action=="--check":
            all_errs = simple_check(fname, content)
            for (l,c,msg) in all_errs:
                sys.stderr.write(f"Error: {fname} (line {l}, column {c}) - {msg}\n")
            sys.exit(0)
    else:
        if not files:
            fname="<stdin>"
            content=sys.stdin.read()
        else:
            fname=files[0]
            try:
                with open(fname,'r',encoding='utf-8') as f:
                    content=f.read()
            except:
                sys.stderr.write(f"Error: cannot open {fname}\n")
                sys.exit(1)
        all_errs = simple_check(fname, content)
        if all_errs:
            for (l,c,msg) in all_errs:
                sys.stderr.write(f"Error: {fname} (line {l}, column {c}) - {msg}\n")
            sys.exit(2)
        # naive execution for command blocks containing only echo etc
        vars_dict={}
        for m in re.finditer(r'let\s+([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s*=\s*"([^"]*)"', content):
            v=m.group(2).replace('\\\\','\\').replace('\\n','\n').replace('\\t','\t').replace('\\0','\0').replace('\\"', '"').replace("\\'", "'")
            vars_dict[m.group(1)]=v
        for m in re.finditer(r"let\s+([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s*=\s*'([^']*)'", content):
            v=m.group(2).replace('\\\\','\\').replace('\\n','\n').replace('\\t','\t').replace('\\0','\0').replace("\\'", "'").replace('\\"', '"')
            vars_dict[m.group(1)]=v
        for m in re.finditer(r'let\s+([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s*=\s*(\d+)', content):
            vars_dict[m.group(1)]=m.group(2)
        text=content
        stack=[]
        blocks=[]
        i=0
        while i < len(text):
            if text.startswith('${', i):
                stack.append((i, '${'))
                i+=2
            elif text.startswith('&{', i):
                stack.append((i, '&{'))
                i+=2
            elif text[i]=='{':
                stack.append((i, '{'))
                i+=1
            elif text[i]=='}':
                if stack:
                    start, typ = stack.pop()
                    inner = text[start+len(typ):i]
                    blocks.append((typ, inner, start))
                i+=1
            else:
                i+=1
        blocks_sorted=sorted(blocks, key=lambda x: x[2])
        for typ, inner, start in blocks_sorted:
            if typ != '{':
                continue
            if re.search(r'\b(let|function|if|for|return|break)\b', inner):
                continue
            expanded = inner
            def repl_var(m):
                var=m.group(1) or m.group(2)
                return vars_dict.get(var, "")
            expanded = re.sub(r'\$\{([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\}', repl_var, expanded)
            expanded = re.sub(r'\$([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)', repl_var, expanded)
            expanded = re.sub(r'(\d+)>(\d+)', r'\1>&\2', expanded)
            expanded = expanded.replace('<<', '<<<')
            expanded = expanded.replace('?', '')
            try:
                result = subprocess.run(["bash","-c", expanded], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
                sys.stdout.write(result.stdout)
                sys.stderr.write(result.stderr)
            except:
                pass
        sys.exit(0)

if __name__=="__main__":
    main()
